This filtered slice brings together programs where listed award amounts stay below that cap, with options tied to themes like education, community, STEM, music, law, and other miscellaneous interests. The rows below span different study levels, from high school applicants to college and graduate paths, and some listings connect to fields such as engineering, business, visual and performing arts, architecture, and education. Requirements are not identical across this set, and essay expectations can vary by listing. Deadlines also differ across programs, so it makes sense to compare details carefully and apply early when a Maine opportunity looks relevant.
